chapter: Recollections of Trent's band and its influence
title: Lunceford drew his style from Trent's band
summary: Lunceford took inspiration from Trent but Willie Smith and Sy Oliver would not acknowledge it.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: One of the most important things that we didn't go over, Frank, was Jimmy Lunceford got his inspiration from Trent's band.
I know that; there's no question about that. All you have to do is hear that "Clementine" and you hear the whole Jimmy Lunceford style, as far as I'm concerned.
Yeah, but you see, when we played--
They didn't want to acknowledge--Lunceford acknowledged it, but Willie Smith and a lot of those other guys didn't want to acknowledge that; it's funny.
Sy Oliver wouldn't acknowledge it either.
